title: wss: ChatPresenceEvent.presence enum mismatches ChatContact.presence
description: ChatContact.presence (main draft) has 4 states: online, away, offline, unknown. ChatPresenceEvent.presence uses 5 states: online, away, busy, invisible, offline (the PresenceStatus self-reported enum). Receiving a ChatPresenceEvent with presence='busy' or 'invisible' has no defined mapping onto ChatContact.presence. Decision: either add the two missing states to ChatContact.presence, restrict ChatPresenceEvent.presence to the ChatContact enum, or explicitly state these values are in-memory-only and not reflected in ChatContact.presence.
close_reason: Expanded ChatContact.presence to 5-state enum (online/away/busy/invisible/offline), made field optional, unknown state represented by field absence. Single edit to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md line 298.
